title: Manage your client’s portable long service (building and construction)
summary: Tax agents can use the LSC Building and Construction portal to lodge certificates of service to the Long Service Corporation (LSC) for their clients.
intro:
If you’re a tax agent and need to lodge certificates of service to the Long Service Corporation (LSC) for your clients, you can do this via the LSC Building and Construction portal.

You must be registered with the Tax Practitioners Board and your client must be registered as a worker with the LSC.

Firstly, you need to register in the portal as a tax agent and then you can:
who_can_apply: Must be registered with the Tax Practitioners Board.
The client must be registered as a worker with the LSC.
what_you_need: The tax practice’s address and contact details
Authorised person’s name and contact details
Email and password used to register the tax practice (for logging into the portal)

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your LSC account, or register as a tax agent.

external_links.text: Portable long service scheme: building and construction – Long Service Corporation

faqs.q: Who can lodge certificates of service?
faqs.a: Tax agents can lodge certificates of service to the Long Service Corporation (LSC) via the LSC Building and Construction portal.

faqs.q: What are the requirements for lodging service certificates?
faqs.a: You must be registered with the Tax Practitioners Board, and your client must be registered as a worker with the LSC.
